evidence.snippet: Michael: Kelly, you are Hindu, so you believe in Buddha.

beats.summary: Dwight argues about Meredith's medical condition and ethics of keeping her alive.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: As a farmer, I know that when an animal is sick, sometimes the right thing to do is to put it out of its misery.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: So, just to be safe they are giving her the rabies vaccine.
